title: Syrian Wensleydale Biryani Keto Delight
description: A keto-friendly twist on the classic biryani dish, combining the flavors of Syria and the nuttiness of Wensleydale cheese.

ingredients.name: Lovely Syrian Rice
ingredients.notes: make sure to rinse the rice well before cooking

ingredients.name: Wensleydale Cheese
ingredients.notes: choose a low-carb, full-fat Wensleydale cheese

ingredients.name: Biryani Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cardamom, and cayenne pepper

instructions: Rinse the rice well and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Drain the rice and cook it in a saucepan with 2 cups of water until it's tender.
In a separate pan, heat the avocado oil and sauté the Wensleydale cheese until it's lightly browned.
Add the biryani spice blend to the cheese and stir well.
Add the cooked rice to the cheese mixture and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Fluff the rice mixture with a fork and stir in the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the biryani to a serving dish and garnish with chopped cilantro.
